name: Lunar
description: In the reviewed Lunar snapshot, Info.plist declares the Sparkle feed at files.lunar.fyi/appcast2.xml and includes a SUPublicEDKey value. This is configuration evidence for a public-key update boundary; release-specific enforcement remains unresolved.
